name: Hindustan Petroleum Corporation Ltd.
about: Hindustan Petroleum Corporation Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the refining and marketing of petroleum products in India and internationally. It operates through Downstream Petroleum and All Other segments. The company offers light distillates, including liquefied petroleum gas, motor spirits, naphtha, hexane, propylene, and solvents; and middle distillates, such as high-speed diesel, superior kerosene oil, light diesel oil, aviation turbine fuels, mineral turpentine oil, jute batching oil, and lube and turbine oil base stocks. It also provides heavy distillates, including bitumen, furnace oil, waxes and low sulphur heavy stock; and compressed natural gas, biofuel blended fuels, lubricants and petrochemicals. verdict.label: Looks expensive
reasons: Price implies ~35% a year profit growth for 10 years, versus ~25% that history and analysts support (reverse DCF at 13.1% cost of equity).
PE of 59 is near the top of its range over the last 3 years (median 5).
Trades at PE 59 vs sector median 17; peers with similar ROCE and growth trade nearer 14, so the premium is not explained by fundamentals alone.
